properties.evidence: Whether serving flo2 costs the local case depends on WHICH LAYER absorbs the scaling work. If it lands in dynograph-foundation as a new `impl KvBackend`, reflow2's shape does not move and the local case is barely at risk. If it lands in reflow2 by loosening "one design = one directory = one engine", the local case is exactly what is being changed. So the cost question cannot be answered before the layer question.
